visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long curly hair, wearing a dark blue t-shirt and a silver necklace, stands in a modern kitchen studio. He holds a yellow circular bag with red accents and a decorative dessert glass. (2) Close-up shots show a metal tray lined with plastic wrap; hands use a spatula to spread a layer of dark chocolate paste. (3) The hands sprinkle chopped brown nuts onto the chocolate layer, then reveal a small yellow and red tub of ice cream. (4) A scoop of white vanilla ice cream is placed on the chocolate and nut layer on the tray. (5) The plastic wrap is gathered and twisted, molding the ice cream and chocolate into a round ball shape. (6) The man is now sitting on a gray sofa, holding the yellow circular bag, which features a brand logo. (7) He unzips the bag to reveal a rolled-up yellow and red blanket inside, which he unfolds to show it mimics the design of an ice cream cup. (8) He wraps the large blanket around his shoulders, demonstrating its texture and cooling effect in the living room setting. (9) He uncurls the plastic wrap to reveal the hardened chocolate-covered ice cream ball and places it back in the glass. (10) He grates a block of yellow cheese over the dessert, adds more nut fragments, sea salt, and a fresh green mint leaf. (11) The man eats the dessert while wrapped in the blanket on the sofa, appearing to shiver as a frozen graphic overlay appears.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 male creator shown in both kitchen and living room environments.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A man with medium-length dark curly hair, wearing a navy blue t-shirt and a silver cross necklace.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video alternates between a well-lit kitchen studio with teal cabinets and a white tile backsplash, and a cozy living room with a gray sofa and domestic decor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins over an upbeat electronic dance BGM. The speaker has a fast speech rate and bright pitch. (2) A sharp scraping sound occurs as chocolate is spread, followed by a series of pop SFX as nuts are sprinkled. (3) A mechanical click is heard when opening the ice cream lid, and a soft thud as the scoop hits the tray. (4) As the plastic uncurls later, a metallic grating sound of cheese on a grater dominates the mid-frequencies. (5) A sharp 'ding' sound signifies the completion of the dish. (6) The final phase features the speaker shivering with a synthesized wind/howling cold SFX layer added for comedic effect while the music continues.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> DIY Process -> Product Intro -> Feature Demo -> Result -> Evaluation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a summer co-branded cooling blanket between lifestyle brand Fei Hang Mo Shi and ice cream brand Shao Mei by using a creative dessert-making hook.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of products, verbal introduction of the brand collaboration, and a final promotion screen with discount details.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes the 'ice cream' brand's visual identity to market a 'cooling' textile product, bridging two industries through sensory cooling themes.
